newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures easier in line with Japan.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures easier in line with Japan.

text.p: Rubber futures drifted marginally lower on Thursday in line with lower Japanese prices and the absence of fresh buying in the local exchange, dealers said.
"There were some inquiries but nothing was traded as usual. It was again a quiet session in the morning with falling Japanese prices adding to the depressed mood," a local rubber trader said.
Tokyo's benchmark April contract dropped one yen to 141.9 while Kobe's April contract dropped 0.8 yen to 142.0.
"It's boring and it's quiet. What else is there to say," another rubber trader said.
At around 0445 GMT, December RSS3 was indicated at 126.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 126.75 cents.
December RSS1 was indicated at 180.75 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg from 181.00 cents.
December TSR20 was indicated at 175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.24) a kg from the previous 176.00 cents.
